citations.title: Lily Ray — AI Visibility Score 84/100 | Personality Audit | IdeaLab AI Visibility OS v1.1
excerpts:
Deploy LLMs.txt on both algorythmic.co and lilyray.nyc — listing the Substack research pieces, the article archive, the E-E-A-T and AEO service pages, and the About page. This is a one-afternoon task that Lily Ray already teaches clients to do. The irony of not having done it for her own domains is not lost on this audit.
Create Wikidata entity — the irony priority +8–10 pts on D3 2 hours · zero cost · today
Create a Wikidata entity for Lily Ray at wikidata.org.
Primary notability references (all independently verifiable): (1) USA Today "10 Most Influential SEO Experts of 2022" — thelistwire.usatoday.com/lists/the-10-most-influential-seo-experts-of-2022 — tier-1 press, named source, verifiable URL.
(5) Algorythmic launch — Prism News, April 2026, independent business press. (6) Affiliate Summit West 2026 keynote — affiliatesummit.com, independent event media.
The article should cover: career timeline (2010 startup → Amsive/Path Interactive), E-E-A-T specialization, USA Today recognition, industry awards, MozCon keynotes, Algorythmic founding (2026), and a brief personal note (DJ, NYU). Article tone: neutral, encyclopedic, third-person, with no promotional language.
Post-Wikipedia: Lily Ray projects to 93 — the highest personality score in the database, surpassing Hormozi by 6 points. The D3 gap is the only thing keeping her from Dominant territory, and it is the most fixable gap of any profile audited.
AUDIT VERDICT
* D4_structured_knowledge | 82 · B — Author schema on SEL/SEJ/Moz. Substack Article schema. algorythmic.co structured service pages. No LLMs.txt. No Person JSON-LD on algorythmic.co.
* D5_multiplatform | 80 · B — X 110K+ (31 posts/week), LinkedIn 43.5K, Bluesky, Substack. Global conference circuit. 10+ indexed speaker profiles.
